description_en: Validates the UDP IP address ranges of Public DNS
description_zh: 验证公共DNS Udp Ip地址段
kebab_example: aliyun alidns validate-pdns-udp-ip-segment --ip example-string --lang example-string --ip-token example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ValidatePdnsUdpIpSegment

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the Public DNS enterprise recursive gateway
parameters.help_zh: 公共 DNS 企业递归网关的 IP 地址
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: Specifies the language of the request and response messages. Valid values: zh for Chinese and en for English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文；默认为 zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The client IP validation token. The service uses this token to look up cached client IP addresses. If no match is found, the client IP address in the request is used
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 IP 校验令牌。服务使用该令牌查找已缓存的客户端 IP；未命中时使用请求中的客户端 IP
parameters.name: ip_token
